_format.note: Alias map that turns messy Opportunity-name 'account cores' into clean accounts. The sync matches each opportunity's core (case-insensitive 'contains') against every string in matchAliases, assigns it to the account id, and attributes it to the CSM via the report's CSM Email column. Fill/adjust and send back.

fields.id: short stable key used by the dashboard/brief
fields.name: friendly display name
fields.csm: owning CSM email (from the report); leave as-is or correct
fields.matchAliases: substrings to match against the opportunity 'core' (lowercased). Add every variant you see.
fields.products: auto-derived from the AQ/AR/AX/BB/AA prefixes; informational
fields.keep: false = ignore this account in the roster
